meta.parties: Pless Pol v. Lady De Soysa Et Al

rules.statement: A failure to perform a contract is considered a 'wrong' for the prevention or redress of which an action may be brought, and this can establish jurisdiction in the court where the breach occurred.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is clear from the definition of the word "action" that the word "wrong" in the definition is not restricted to "torts. " If the plaintiff had averred an express refusal to fulfil the contract the jurisdiction of the Court of Kandy could not have been disputed, for refusal to fulfil an obligation is specified in the definition as a cause of action."
